name: taxline
description: Taxline: agentic tax operations. An AI agent fleet, a tested 2026 tax engine, free calculators, and human approval before anything ships.

scripts.typecheck: npm run check && npm --prefix packages/tax-engine run typecheck && npm --prefix service run typecheck && npm --prefix workers/contact run typecheck
scripts.test: npm test --workspace @taxline/tax-engine && npm --prefix service test && npm --prefix workers/contact test
scripts.llms: BASE_PATH=/taxline npm run build && cp site/dist/llms.txt llms.txt
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && npm run test:e2e && npm --prefix cms run typecheck && npm --prefix cms run build && npm run verify:python
scripts.verify:python: cd python && uv sync --locked && uv run ruff check . && uv run ruff format --check . && uv run mypy && TAXLINE_PARITY_REQUIRED=1 uv run pytest
scripts.report: cd python && uv run python -m taxline_quant report
scripts.verify:fast: npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run typecheck && npm test
